tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search the published Dev.cards UI components (hero sections, pricing tables, dashboards, forms, navigation and more) by text and implementation target. Returns compact metadata: id, version, name, category, description and targets. Leave q empty to list every component.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get metadata, the design specification, source references and the available implementations of one component by id.

tools.name: get_component_code
tools.description: Get the complete, pre-generated source files of one component for one tested target, with their SHA-256 hashes, setup instructions and pinned dependencies. Vanilla is javascript; React is typescript. Styling is always css.
